entities.name: Authentication procedure
entities.description: The authentication procedure between UE and network that can encounter various abnormal cases including lower layer failures, timer expiries, and authentication failures.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to initiate authentication procedure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network in response to successful authentication challenge.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network indicating authentication failure with specific EMM causes.

entities.name: T3460
entities.description: Timer used by network for AUTHENTICATION REQUEST retransmission. Retransmitted four times before procedure abort.

entities.name: T3418
entities.description: Timer started by UE when sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE with EMM cause #20 or #26.

entities.name: T3420
entities.description: Timer started by UE when sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE with EMM cause #21.

entities.name: EMM cause #20 MAC failure
entities.description: Authentication failure condition where MAC validation fails.

entities.name: EMM cause #21 synch failure
entities.description: Authentication failure condition requiring re-synchronization with HSS.

entities.name: EMM cause #26 non-EPS authentication unacceptable
entities.description: Authentication failure condition where non-EPS authentication is not acceptable.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: Network behavior to abort authentication procedure and release NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Procedure re-initiation
entities.description: UE behavior to re-initiate tracking area updating or attach procedure after transmission failure.

relations.description: Authentication procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
Authentication procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message upon successful validation.
Authentication procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message upon authentication failure.
Sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST starts timer T3460.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE with EMM cause #20 or #26 starts timer T3418.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE with EMM cause #21 starts timer T3420.
EMM cause #20 MAC failure condition triggers AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
EMM cause #21 synch failure condition triggers AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
EMM cause #26 non-EPS authentication unacceptable condition triggers AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
Fifth expiry of timer T3460 establishes procedure abortion.
Receiving new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST stops timer T3418 if running.
Receiving new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST stops timer T3420 if running.
Synch failure condition may establish procedure re-initiation after transmission failure.
